components.name: LoadGauge
components.summary: The live centrepiece: a 270° arc that shows load from 0 to 100%, the current context, and how sure CLR is.

components.name: ContextPill
components.summary: A small chip that names the student's current context with a colour, an icon and the exact label.

components.name: Breakdown
components.summary: Three bars that split load into intrinsic, extraneous and germane, each with a one-line plain-English explanation.

components.name: ConnectionStatus
components.summary: Shows whether the engine is live and which sources are sending data right now.

components.name: StatTile
components.summary: A compact number tile for KPIs and "today at a glance", plus the context-distribution bar.

components.name: DirectiveCard
components.summary: One thing the engine is doing or suggesting right now: icon, short label, and the reason in plain words.

components.name: TaskRow
components.summary: One task in the queue: done check, title, difficulty, estimate and tags, with a highlighted state for the one CLR recommends now.

components.name: DifficultyChip
components.summary: Difficulty as shape, not colour: 1, 2 or 3 bars for easy, medium and hard, and a book for review.

components.name: Timer
components.summary: The adaptive Pomodoro: a ring countdown with session dots and a line that explains why the session is this long.

components.name: MiniPlayer
components.summary: The running timer as a slim bar, so a focus session or Pomodoro is visible from every screen.

components.name: PlaybackControls
components.summary: Transport for timeline replay: jump to start, step back, play/pause, step forward, jump to end, plus a speed switch.

components.name: ChartStyle
components.summary: How every chart in CLR is styled in Recharts: the live load line, replay, daily focus bars, context mix, and the best-hours heatmap.

components.name: Slider
components.summary: A Settings slider with the current value, its default marked as a tick, "Reset to default", and a hatched range it can't enter.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: An on/off switch with a check mark in the thumb, so the state never depends on colour alone.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Buttons in four variants (primary, secondary, ghost, danger) plus a rest variant for break screens, in three sizes, with loading and disabled states.

components.name: TextField
components.summary: A labelled text input with an icon, help text, inline error and valid states, and a password reveal.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.summary: A row of mutually exclusive options, plus the context filter chips used in the event log.

components.name: TabBar
components.summary: The mobile bottom tab bar (Now, Focus, Tasks, Insights, More) and the mobile top bar with the live load pill.

components.name: Sidebar
components.summary: The desktop sidebar with the brand, the always-visible live mini-gauge and connection status, the six sections, the running timer, and the account.

components.name: BottomSheet
components.summary: A sheet that rises from the bottom on mobile and becomes a centred dialog on desktop, used for add task, confirmations and break prompts.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: Short in-app alerts for context changes, the overload warning and break prompts, plus how the same messages look as Android notifications.

components.name: Banner
components.summary: An inline notice at the top of a card or screen: reorder explanations, low confidence, reconnecting, offline and errors.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: A friendly placeholder for when there's nothing to show yet, with the next step as a button.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: Loading placeholders that copy the shape of the real layout, so nothing jumps when the data arrives.

components.name: SourceCard
components.summary: A card for one data source (Browser extension, VS Code, Desktop agent, LMS) in one of three states: not connected, waiting with a pairing code, or connected.

components.name: BlockedOverlay
components.summary: The full-page overlay shown over a distracting site during focus mode, gentle, with a deliberate 5-minute escape.

components.name: ExtensionPopup
components.summary: The browser extension popup at 360 × 520: mini live gauge, context, breakdown, focus toggle and connection status.

components.name: ScreenAlerts
components.summary: Context-change toasts, the overload warning, break prompts, and the same messages as Android notifications.

components.name: ScreenAuth
components.summary: Sign in, create account, forgot password and set new password, at desktop 1440 and mobile 390.

components.name: ScreenFocus
components.summary: Focus mode and the adaptive Pomodoro, plus the break screen that deliberately feels different from work.

components.name: ScreenHistory
components.summary: The live 5-minute load chart, timeline replay of a past session, session stats and the event log.

components.name: ScreenInsights
components.summary: Weekly analytics: KPI tiles, daily focus bars, context mix per day, the day-by-day table, and two future slots (weekly reflection and best hours).

components.name: ScreenNow
components.summary: Home: the live gauge, breakdown, directives, recommended next task, quick actions and today at a glance.

components.name: ScreenOnboarding
components.summary: Four short steps: what CLR does, the privacy promise, connecting sources, and turning on notifications.

components.name: ScreenSettings
components.summary: Settings: Pomodoro lengths, load thresholds with their constraint, session gap, notifications, connected sources, account and privacy.

components.name: ScreenStates
components.summary: The system states every screen needs: loading, reconnecting, offline, no data yet, low confidence and error.

components.name: ScreenTasks
components.summary: The task queue, reordered by current load, with an explanation banner, the recommended task, add task, and the empty state.

components.name: VSCodeStatusBar
components.summary: The VS Code status-bar item format: one line with a codicon, load and context, plus its colours.
